title: Words I Swallowed
narrative: The narrator watches the person they secretly loved start a relationship with someone else, wishing they had spoken up in time.
relationship_dynamics: Secret admirer on the sidelines of someone else's new relationship.
lyrical_meaning: The ache of silence that made the narrator too late to be chosen.

title: Long Distance Ghost
narrative: Two inseparable best friends slowly lose touch after one moves away, until messages become rare and awkward.
relationship_dynamics: Former best friends separated by distance, one clinging to old memories.
lyrical_meaning: Grieving a friendship that dissolved through distance, not conflict.

title: Clock Out For Good
narrative: After quitting a draining job, the narrator feels free but lost, and guilty about coworkers left behind.
relationship_dynamics: Individual versus a toxic workplace and the colleagues still inside it.
lyrical_meaning: The strange emptiness of freedom when your sense of purpose was tied to suffering.

title: Burn the Letters
narrative: The narrator discovers a partner's cheating and cuts them off furiously.
relationship_dynamics: Betrayed partner confronting an unfaithful ex.

title: Empty Kitchen
narrative: The narrator stands in a parent's kitchen after the funeral, surrounded by small reminders.
lyrical_meaning: Ordinary objects becoming unbearable after a loss.

title: Saturday Static
narrative: A group of friends spends a night dancing and forgetting their worries.
lyrical_meaning: Pure escapism and living in the moment.

title: Maybe It Was Me
narrative: After a breakup, the narrator replays the relationship wondering what they did wrong.
lyrical_meaning: Taking the blame for a love that ended.

title: First Light
narrative: Two people realize they are falling for each other over a quiet morning.
relationship_dynamics: New couple at the start of a relationship.
lyrical_meaning: The giddy hope of a love just starting.
